question: 'Streets Of Calcutta' and 'Dancing Drums' are the two popular tracks of _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ananda Shankar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Ananda Shankar** was a renowned Indian musician known for blending Indian classical music with Western rock and electronic music.
 
• The tracks **'Streets of Calcutta'** and **'Dancing Drums'** are iconic pieces from his album released in the 1970s, showcasing his experimental fusion style.
 
• Ananda Shankar was the nephew of the legendary sitar virtuoso **Ravi Shankar**, but he carved his own niche in the global music scene.
 
• His work contributed significantly to the genre of world music, influencing generations of artists in both India and abroad.
 
• Ananda Shankar's music featured instruments like the sitar alongside synthesizers, creating a unique and groundbreaking sound.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **World Music:** A genre that combines traditional music from various cultures with modern elements, promoting cross-cultural musical exchange.
 
• **Fusion Music:** A style that blends multiple musical traditions, such as classical Indian music with Western pop, rock, or electronic genres.
 
• **Sitar:** A traditional Indian string instrument prominently used in Indian classical music and famously associated with Ravi Shankar.
 
• **Electronic Music:** A genre of music that uses electronic instruments, synthesizers, and digital technology for production and composition.
 
• Ananda Shankar's work has been featured in several international compilations, highlighting his contributions to experimental and world music.
